name: Ruby
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a Ruby app, such as a Discord bot or a Sinatra or Rails site, from your files or a Git repository. Gems in the Gemfile are installed with Bundler when it changes.
startup: if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; export PORT={{SERVER_PORT}}; export BUNDLE_WITHOUT="{{BUNDLE_WITHOUT}}"; [ -n "$BUNDLE_WITHOUT" ] || unset BUNDLE_WITHOUT; if [ -n "{{RUBY_GEMS}}" ]; then gem install --conservative --no-document {{RUBY_GEMS}} || exit 1; fi; deps() { (ruby --version; echo "{{BUNDLE_WITHOUT}}"; cat Gemfile Gemfile.lock 2>/dev/null) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1; }; if [ -f Gemfile ]; then if [ "$(deps)" != "$(cat .gem/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then MAKEFLAGS=-j2 bundle install --jobs 2 || { echo "Bundler couldn't install the gems in the Gemfile."; exit 1; }; mkdir -p .gem && deps > .gem/.raptor-installed; fi; exec bundle exec ruby "{{RUBY_FILE}}" {{RUBY_ARGS}}; fi; exec ruby "{{RUBY_FILE}}" {{RUBY_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Ruby: clones the app's Git repository, if one is set. Files already in
# the server's folder are never deleted or overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

clone() {
    local url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
        echo "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" . || {
            echo "The repository couldn't be cloned: check its address, and the username and access token for a private one."
            exit 1
        }
    fi
}

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
    clone
else
    echo "No Git repository set: upload your app's files, then start the server."
fi
echo "Installed."

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file that starts your app, such as app.rb, bot.rb or bin/rails.

variables.name: Groups to skip
variables.description: Gemfile groups Bundler leaves out, separated by colons; empty installs every group.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the app's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.

variables.name: Extra gems
variables.description: Gems to install as well, for an app without a Gemfile, separated by spaces.

variables.name: Arguments
variables.description: Arguments passed to your app, such as server -b 0.0.0.0 for Rails, which listens on the server's port (PORT).
